buffer_size.docs:
**int**: The size of the internal buffer for storing the remote codes. Defaults to `10kB` on the ESP32 and `1kB` on the ESP8266.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

carrier_duty_percent.docs:
**int**: The carrier duty cycle for signal demodulation in the RMT peripheral in Hz. Defaults to `100`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

carrier_frequency.docs:
**int**: The carrier frequency for signal demodulation in the RMT peripheral in Hz. Defaults to `0Hz` (carrier demodulation disabled).

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

clock_resolution.docs:
**int**: The clock resolution used by the RMT peripheral in Hz. Defaults to `1000000`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

dump.docs:
**list**: Decode and dump these remote codes in the logs (at log.level=DEBUG). Set to `all` to dump all available codecs:

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

filter.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Filter any pulses that are shorter than this. Useful for removing glitches from noisy signals. Allowed values are in range `0` to `4294967295us`. Defaults to `50us`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

filter_symbols.docs:
**int**: Filter out any data received with a length in symbols less than `filter_symbols`. Useful for filtering out short bursts of noise.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. Useful when multiple receivers are configured on a single device.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

idle.docs:

receive_symbols.docs:
**int**: Maximum receive length in symbols. On some variants the maximum receive is limited to `rmt_symbols`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

rmt_symbols.docs:
**int**: When `use_dma` is enabled, this sets the size of the driver's internal DMA buffer. When DMA is disabled, it specifies how much RMT memory is allocated to the component. RMT memory is shared across all components and should be allocated in multiples of the block size. On the `ESP32` and `ESP32-S2` variants, RMT memory is shared between RX and TX components. On other variants, RX and TX have dedicated RMT memory.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

tolerance.docs:
**int**: The percentage or time that the remote signal lengths can deviate in the decoding process. Defaults to `25%`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

use_dma.docs:
**boolean**: Enable DMA on variants that support it. If enabled `rmt_symbols` controls the DMA buffer size and can be set to a large value.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

data.docs:
**0-7 bytes list**: The code to listen for. Usually you only need to copy this directly from the dumper output. Defaults to `[]`

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

destination_address.docs:
**int**: The destination address to trigger on.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

message_id.docs:
**int**: The random message ID to trigger on, see dumper output for more info. Defaults to any ID.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

message_type.docs:

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

retransmission.docs:
**boolean**: `true` if the message was re-transmitted. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

source_address.docs:
**int**: The source address to trigger on.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*

three_byte_address.docs:
**boolean**: The length of the source and destination address. `false` means two bytes and `true` means three bytes. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver#configuration-variables)*
